title.narrative: Rusizi II One Stop Border Post (OSBP)

description.narrative: Rusizi II border post is located in the western part of Rwanda and is the main entrance and exit border between Rusizi and Bukavu trading areas used mainly by heavy trucks destined to and from to Bukavu. The border post has been characterised by old small infrastructure with no clear operational flow of goods and passenger handling. Unharmonized procedures that do not facilitate smooth flow of business at the border post. The Construction of a One Stop Border Post (OSBP) and implementation of integrated Border Management (IBM) at Rusizi II border will facilitate the smooth and efficient cross border movement of vehicles passengers between Rwanda and DRC Congo. It is planned that the modern border post will cater for the heavy truck traffic, smaller-scale traders and crossing passengers
